summary: Iteration-2 retest of CorpZo Debt CRM. Backend: 67 pytest cases (existing backend_test.py + new test_iter2_fixes.py) — 66 passed / 1 failed. All iter1 HIGH items verified FIXED: POST /api/tasks now 422 on missing title and defaults due_date; POST /api/invoices & /api/payments return 422 on missing fields; invoice total_amount = amount*(1+gst/100)*(1-tds/100) and payment status is computed against total_amount (base-amount payment correctly leaves part_paid); dashboard funnel/top_lenders/invoices_summary and reports/pipeline now return stage/lender_id/status keys (no _id leak); documents/upload recomputes case.documentation_pct per unique category and version chain v1->v2->v3 with correct superseded_by; 40+ documents, 6 lender queries and mandates across all 6 statuses are seeded. Frontend: verified new data-testids (7 mark-paid-*, 10 advance-*, 10 role-select-*, all 9 CaseDetail tab-*), upload dialog with category select (12 options) + doc_type input + file chooser works and doc completeness moved 0%->8%, LeadDetail header no longer shows dangling separators. Full UI regression PASSED end-to-end: New Lead -> log call activity -> Convert (navigates to new case) -> upload doc (doc completeness up) -> sandbox bureau pull -> lender application -> Record Sanction (stage=Sanctioned) -> Record Disbursement (stage=Fully Disbursed, incentive accrued) -> Mandate Advance (internal_approval -> sent) -> Admin role change persisted + Audit Log entry. Two new defects found: Invoices 'Mark Paid' pays base amount so GST invoices stay part_paid and the button never clears; Sanction/Disburse dialogs never close after save (uncontrolled Dialog). Test data cleaned; baseline restored (leads=30, clients=10, cases=15, documents=40, mandates=11 across 6 statuses, EMP-0010 role restored to sales_agent).

minor.issue: bureau_checks and assessments are still not seeded (bureau=0, assessments=0 after cleanup) — Bureau and Assessments pages are empty on a fresh env. test_iter2_fixes.py::TestSeededData::test_bureau_checks_present is the 1 failing test.

Seeded invoices (INV-2026-000001..000011) have no total_amount field; only API-created invoices get it. Payment logic falls back to amount so behaviour differs between seeded and new invoices. Backfill total_amount in seed.

Still $set the whole request body (no allow-list) — protected keys (task_id, case_uid, created_at, employee_uid) can be overwritten. cases/leads/clients/mandates/applications/documents were fixed; these were not.
Validation is still hand-rolled if-checks inside handlers; models.py (524 lines) remains dead code. Non-numeric 'amount' or bad types will still raise 500 (float() ValueError).

ui_bugs.issue: collect() posts amount: inv.amount (base) while the backend now settles against total_amount (GST/TDS inclusive). Clicking Mark Paid on a GST invoice leaves status=part_paid, the button stays visible and every extra click creates another duplicate payment. Reproduced on INV-2026-000017 (amount 100, total 118 -> part_paid after click). Also the table shows only base Amount, never total_amount.

Both are rendered as uncontrolled <Dialog> (CaseDetail.jsx lines ~271 and ~307) while the handlers call setSancOpen(false)/setDisbOpen(false), which are no-ops. After 'Save Sanction'/'Save Disbursement' the record is created but the modal stays open over the refreshed page (verified by screenshot).
React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' logged twice — add DialogDescription.
Still open from iter1: 'Configure →' links are non-functional placeholders.

CaseDetail 'New application'/'Apply'/'Sanction'/'Disburse' buttons and the sanction/disbursement dialog inputs + save buttons still have no data-testid (tests fall back to role/text). Clients/Applications/Sanctions/Disbursements table rows also lack row testids.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend/backend contract mismatch on invoice settlement amount (base vs total_amount) — invoice can never reach 'paid' from the UI for any invoice with GST.

issues: Still empty on a fresh environment because bureau_checks and assessments are not seeded
Still no loading skeleton — headers paint before data resolves (~1s)

action_items: Invoices.jsx collect(): pay (inv.total_amount ?? inv.amount) minus already-collected, and display total_amount in the table
Make the CaseDetail Sanction and Disburse dialogs controlled (open={sancOpen}/open={disbOpen} + onOpenChange) so they close after save
Seed bureau_checks and credit assessments (and backfill total_amount on seeded invoices)
Adopt Pydantic request models (models.py) so bad types return 422 instead of 500
Add data-testid to CaseDetail application/sanction/disbursement buttons, their dialog inputs and save buttons
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~1340 lines / 60+ routes in one module — split into routers
The ObjectId leak is still guarded only by 22 hand-written doc.pop('_id', None) calls; one missed insert re-introduces a 500. Wrap inserts in a helper or use response_model
documentation_pct hard-codes a divisor of 12 inline in upload_document — move the required-category list to a constant/config so the metric is auditable
Frontend invoice/payment amount logic duplicates backend GST/TDS math implicitly; expose and consume total_amount everywhere

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (full lead->disbursement regression passes; Invoices Mark Paid broken, sanction/disburse modals don't close)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_QA leads/clients/cases/applications/sanctions/disbursements/documents/mandates/invoices/payments/tasks via API and UI, then purged with `mongosh test_database /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.js` plus deletion of EMP-0001 test incentives. Baseline verified: leads=30, clients=10, cases=15, documents=40, lender_queries=6, mandates=11 (all 6 statuses present), seeded incentives=3. EMP-0010 role restored to sales_agent. Side effects left behind: UI test advanced MAN-2026-000002 internal_approval->sent, and INV-2026-000017 is part_paid from the Mark-Paid bug.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_supertoken (API) / cookie session_token=test_session_supertoken (browser), user corpzoindia@gmail.com role super_admin. Token was valid throughout this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; cross-class state must use conftest fixtures ent/application). test_iter2_fixes.py covers the iter1 regressions (422 validation, invoice total_amount, dashboard/pipeline keys, documentation_pct + version chain, seeded volumes). After any run execute `mongosh test_database /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.js`. Not retested this round: Assessments page write flow, Queries page write flow, mobile/tablet responsiveness, notifications bell, Documents/Bureau standalone list pages, logout. Next round should re-verify Invoices Mark Paid -> status=paid and that sanction/disbursement dialogs close.
rca_of_the_issue: Invoices Mark Paid: backend POST /api/payments now compares cumulative payments against invoice.total_amount (GST/TDS inclusive), but Invoices.jsx still posts inv.amount (base). For an 18% GST invoice the collected amount is always ~85% of the target so status is set to part_paid, the 'Mark Paid' button (rendered only when status !== 'paid') never disappears and repeat clicks insert duplicate payment rows. Fix in the frontend by paying total_amount (minus already-received) or add a backend 'settle invoice' endpoint. Sanction/Disburse dialogs: they are declared as bare <Dialog> without open/onOpenChange, so the setSancOpen(false)/setDisbOpen(false) calls inside recordSanction/recordDisbursement cannot close them.
